title: LoopICL: Looping a single transformer block to solve tabular tasks
abstract: arXiv:2609.36108v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Tabular foundation models using in-context learning have recently surpassed gradient-boosted trees on predictive tabular tasks. However, recent mechanistic insights suggest that parameters in these models are largely redundant. We introduce LoopICL, a looped transformer whose core design decouples parameter count from computational depth. LoopICL consists of a single block, processing data through two coupled streams: a cell stream capturing per-cell feature representations and a row stream capturing in-context example representations, jointly refined through within-column and cross-column attention. During pre-training, we vary loop counts, allowing the block to be unrolled for a varying number of iterations at test-time and use a learned exit-gate to automatically exit. In its standard setting, LoopICL performs competitively with TabICLv2 on TabArena and TALENT at the same computational cost (FLOPs), while using nearly 90% fewer para

translated_title: LoopICL：循环单个Transformer块以解决表格任务
translated_abstract: 使用上下文学习的表格基础模型最近在预测性表格任务上超越了梯度提升树。然而，最新的机制分析表明这些模型的参数在很大程度上是冗余的。我们提出了LoopICL，一种循环Transformer，其核心设计将参数数量与计算深度解耦。LoopICL由单个块组成，通过两条耦合的数据流处理数据：捕获每个单元格特征表示的单元格流和捕获上下文样本表示的行流，二者通过列内注意力和跨列注意力共同细化。在预训练期间，我们改变循环次数，使该块在测试时可以展开为不同数量的迭代，并通过学习到的退出门自动决定退出。在标准设置下，LoopICL在相同计算成本（FLOPs）下，在TabArena和TALENT基准上与TabICLv2表现相当，同时参数量减少了近90%。
tldr: LoopICL通过循环单个Transformer块将参数数量与计算深度解耦，在相同计算成本下以减少近90%的参数实现了与TabICLv2相当的表格任务性能。
en_tdlr: LoopICL decouples parameter count from computational depth by looping a single transformer block, achieving performance competitive with TabICLv2 on tabular tasks at the same computational cost while using nearly 90% fewer parameters.
